desc: Parse input via sys.stdin.buffer; group items by vitamin into lists of (C, A).
Implement `min_cal(items, T)`: capped 0/1 knapsack over calories, return smallest c with dp[c] >= T or None (numpy + pure-Python fallback).
Implement feasibility `ok(T)`: sum of three min_calories ≤ X with early exit; empty group → answer 0.
Binary search T in [0, min per-group sum of A]; print answer.

Verify correctness on samples and edge cases (single item groups, T=0, all calories exactly X, large A values); confirm numpy update semantics and fallback correctness; assess performance risk of pure-Python fallback and add early-exit optimization if needed.
